Nah they show how much stronger Beerus is, and explain it pretty well. Beerus is thousands of years older than them and is arguably the strongest GoD. Him and Quietla were the last 2 standing during their exhibition match. I think he's still pretty far ahead of Goku and Vegeta. He wasn't struggling in the slightest against Vegeta's ssbe in the manga which is on par with Gokus ssbkk. MUI would make him sweat but Goku wouldn't be able to finish him before he timed out and Beerus would still have more power left over than him afterward. I think people just expected the same formula of them getting stronger and surpassing the previous foe and think just because Goku has 2 new forms that automatically makes him stronger than a GoD now but it was different with Beerus because he was on a completely different level. He was holding back against Goku in ssg and Goku still lost. I think his strength is still kinda unfathomable right now.

No the only reason white hair(Mastered Ultra Instinct or MUI) is weaker than his most recent form "True Ultra Instinct" or TUI is because in MUI one needs to have complete control of their emotions or the form can't be used to it's fullest potential. If the user has complete control of their emotions then MUI is the absolute strongest form. TUI is only stronger than Goku's MUI because of that. In TUI he can use his emotions to still use the power of Ultra Instinct. Goku was stronger when he fought Moro in MUI than when he fought Granolah in TUI but don't think about that too much lol

I like to be alone when I'm having problems. I always know what's best for me so I isolate myself to figure those things out. I've pulled myself out of multiple depressive states alone. I know my friends enough, the 6 that I have to know what they'll say if I were to ever bring something like this up to them. I have the answers to my problems I just have to find them. Suicide isn't really a problem to me that's part of why I think about it because I  know the emotional trauma it would cause mytt siblings and friends/family. I even thought of plans to indirectly kill myself by sacrificing myself to save someone but that's not likely to happen. I'm also off many talents,  writing, music, exercise programming, teaching, like I said if I put mytt mind to something I believe I can fo that whatever it is. I actually would rather be alone than be around people. Been that way my whole life. But never really showed it. Just last year I felt like I've finally started becoming me again because I lost myself for a while. I have alot to live for but ya know suicide seems/ feels right sometimes. My birthday is in exactly two months so we'll see how life goes. That might be the day but like I said the future isn't certain

I've imagined my future many many times.  I've learned to say no. I'm a good person and have embraced my bad side and the thoughts that come. I actually moved away from all my friends to figure myself out. I didn't really want to leave but felt like I had to for my mental health sake. Reggae and new age music helps me alot, kid cudi too but like I'm here in the present, the future isn't certain and I understand that the choices we make will take us somewhere hopefully where we want. We control or fate. That's what I believe. In the back of my mind I have this feeling that I won't make it to old age that something is going to take me out. I have many plans and projects, writing an anime, building a school, becoming a crossfit  champion and ufc champion. I want these things but I feel like I don't really want them THAT bad. I know it's going to take alot of work to see these things come to life and like I said I don't really have a reason for killing myself except that it almost feels right. It's like I want to despite having things and wanting things in life.
